suggestions.note_kg_units: k_g measured in raw XLS units. If gyro is in rad/s: multiply by 180/pi to get deg/s. Simulation uses deg/s, so measured k_g ~ X -> sim k_g = X*(180/pi).
suggestions.suggested_FREQ_RANGE_HZ_source: arm locations (Upper Left/Right), tremor-present PD windows

pd_upper_end_rms.note: Tremor-present PD windows at arm locations (Upper+Lower Left/Right). Uses pre-computed bandpass RMS -- no re-filtering.

method.reference_rule: per subject: activity with highest median amplitude
method.severity_rule: reference median mapped to SCORE_RMS_RANGE with clamping

method.reference_rule: per subject: stronger of Lower Right / Lower Left
method.severity_rule: reference median mapped to SCORE_RMS_RANGE with clamping

method.poor_definition: PD windows outside SIM p5-p95 for acc_rms OR dom_freq
